name: Template: Both defaults retain distinct permissions in order hit then miss
setup: $TC p4template create pipeline/ptables pipeid 22 numtables 1
$TC p4template create action/ptables/test actid 1 param param1 type bit32
$TC p4template update action/ptables/test num_prealloc_acts 16 state active
$TC p4template create table/ptables/cb/tname tblid 1 keysz 16 table_acts act name ptables/test act name NoAction default_hit_action action ptables/test param param1 7 index 17
$TC p4template update table/ptables/cb/tname default_miss_action action ptables/test param param1 9 index 18
$TC -j p4template get table/ptables/cb/tname >/tmp/p4tc-defparse-$TESTID.json
cmdUnderTest: $TC p4template update table/ptables/cb/tname default_hit_action permissions 0x1424 default_miss_action permissions 0x1c24
verifyCmd: sh -c '$TC -j p4template get table/ptables/cb/tname | python3 -c '"'"'import json,sys; before=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); after=json.load(sys.stdin); assert len(before)==len(after)==1; before[0]["default_hit"]["permissions"]="-R-D----R--X--"; before[0]["default_miss"]["permissions"]="-RUD----R--X--"; assert after==before,(before,after); print("preserved")'"'"' /tmp/p4tc-defparse-$TESTID.json'
